candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 because order's calls to payment time out: payment POST /v1/authorizations spans ~2s and ends with transport ReadTimeout, propagating 502 up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment timeouts but no payment-side latency metrics; whether payment is slow or unreachable is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing with 502 while inventory/redis succeed; the failing span is order->payment POST /v1/authorizations ending in transport ReadTimeout (~2s), matching the ~2s 502 durations. Gateway metrics show checkout 502s and p95 ~2406ms. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment-side slowness rather than network failure
Payment service logs for the timed-out authorization requests
